decision: Recorded Mira's ruling as ADR 0024 (her own words, the reserved number), because it is her decision on direction. Added a pointer comment in src/report_mailer.js. I implemented nothing, and the ADR linter passes.

recorded.info: New ADR 0024, Accepted, with Mira's verbatim words. Rule: report emails save the report, read it back from the store and mail the copy that came back. Reason: a total was disputed in September and we could not show what had been sent. Lists src/report_mailer.js under Protects.
Added one comment line near the top, 'see docs/adr/0024-report-emails-mail-the-copy-read-back-from-the-store.md', so the ruling is findable from the code. No logic changed.
